title: Entropy Obstruction to Closed Semiclassical Bounces
summary: We prove a finite-$G\hslash$ singularity theorem for semiclassical spacetimes with compact Cauchy slices. Let a compact Cauchy slice be divided by a compact surface into regions $B$ and $C$. Suppose that $B$ is conditionally hyperentropic, $H_{\max,\mathrm{gen}}^\varepsilon(BC|C)>0$, that the future-inward null boundary from the dividing surface toward $B$ is a discrete max lightsheet, and that $C$ is robustly quantum trapped.
